answer: Task allocation weights each agent's bid by the square of its accumulated crystal, earned at one crystal per epoch of audited task completion inside the garden. Since crystal is non-transferable and tied to a single identity, splitting work across clones destroys voting weight. An honest agent working 10 epochs in the garden earns 10 crystal for a routing weight of 100, and pays 10 saffron per epoch to keep its slot active. To match that 100 weight using $k$ sybil identities after 10 epochs, an operator must complete $10\sqrt{k}$ total epochs of audited work and burn $10k$ saffron per epoch.
